name: near-agent-guard
description: MCP server for NEAR AI agents, providing policy enforcement and safe transaction execution via GuardVault
author: memgochain

near_ai_cloud.purpose: AI agent intent generation and NEAR policy recommendations
near_ai_cloud.authentication: Bearer token via NEAR_AI_API_KEY environment variable
near_ai_cloud.fallback: CEREBRAS_API_KEY or local simulation if no key provided

guard_vault.description: Agent holds only a function-call key scoped to GuardVault. It cannot transfer directly, edit limits, add allowlist entries, or anchor reports.
